item.headline: Fed's Waller says stablecoins could extend reach of U.S. monetary policy
causal_chain: A sitting Fed governor frames stablecoins as a tool to extend U.S. monetary policy reach — signaling regulatory openness rather than hostility
Reduced regulatory risk premium on dollar-denominated stablecoin infrastructure; crypto-adjacent equities re-rate modestly as institutional legitimacy narrative advances
Crypto exchanges and custody platforms (COIN) are most directly exposed; payments rails with stablecoin ambitions (PYPL) benefit on reduced compliance drag
item.directional_bias: mildly bullish crypto-adjacent equities; dollar-stablecoin infrastructure specifically

sizing_recommendation.rationale: Forward-looking policy commentary only — no rate decision, no legislation, no enforcement action; insufficient mechanistic force to justify entry without confirming Layer 3 positioning or Layer 0/sector catalyst

item.reasoning: Waller's comment is thematically constructive for the stablecoin/crypto complex but carries no immediate policy force — it is a single Fed governor expressing a view, not a rule, guidance document, or rate action. The causal chain is real but elongated (Fed rhetoric → reduced regulatory discount → equity re-rate requires congressional or SEC follow-through). No portfolio positions are affected. Confidence is capped at 0.35 per the forward_looking_only and low_specificity flags. Stand down until the narrative crystallizes into policy action.

item.headline: Broad-based market strength gives investors reason to stay the course
causal_chain: Narrative piece observes participation broadening beyond mega-cap tech into cyclicals and mid-caps
Broad participation is associated with healthier bull market internals — reduces single-factor concentration risk in indices
Equal-weight and cyclical exposures may outperform cap-weight in a broadening tape; sentiment reinforcement may sustain risk appetite near-term
item.directional_bias: mildly bullish broad market; rotation out of pure mega-cap concentration

sizing_recommendation.rationale: Sentiment/narrative piece with no new data event; causal chain is observational rather than catalytic — no actionable entry signal generated

item.reasoning: This is a commentary piece, not an event. The observation that breadth is improving is modestly positive context for risk-on positioning across the portfolio (NOW, VEEV, CEG, MSFT are all indirect beneficiaries of sustained risk appetite), but there is no discrete catalyst here. No override fires. The value is contextual — it is consistent with holding current positions — but generates no new entry signal. Stand down.
